description: This file defines interfaces and extension classes related to transaction attribution grains in Orleans, including various attribution options and a factory extension method for obtaining grains based on transaction options.

classes.name: NoAttributionGrain
classes.description: Wrapper class implementing ITransactionAttributionGrain for grains with no attribution.

classes.name: SuppressAttributionGrain
classes.description: Wrapper class implementing ITransactionAttributionGrain for grains with suppress attribution option.

classes.name: CreateOrJoinAttributionGrain
classes.description: Wrapper class implementing ITransactionAttributionGrain for grains with create or join attribution option.

classes.name: CreateAttributionGrain
classes.description: Wrapper class implementing ITransactionAttributionGrain for grains with create attribution option.

classes.name: JoinAttributionGrain
classes.description: Wrapper class implementing ITransactionAttributionGrain for grains with join attribution option.

classes.name: SupportedAttributionGrain
classes.description: Wrapper class implementing ITransactionAttributionGrain for grains with supported attribution option.

classes.name: NotAllowedAttributionGrain
classes.description: Wrapper class implementing ITransactionAttributionGrain for grains with not allowed attribution option.

methods.name: GetTransactionAttributionGrain
methods.description: Extension method to obtain an ITransactionAttributionGrain based on grain factory, grain ID, and optional transaction option.
